rv.q: This play isn't going to rock your world but if you're looking for a light, funny summer comedy this is the show for you.
It is a light, bright summer entertainment -- very, very old-fashioned, but respectfully and respectably done.

cn.t: This Edwardian comedy pleases crowds with its warm humor and vivid characters, though critics find it very old-fashioned. The period piece delivers respectful, respectable entertainment despite its dated sensibilities.
